sample_unit: held-out test patients (OCT; 124 flagged cases routed to agents)

links.outcome: Accuracy of multi-agent VLM versus classifier on same flagged cases
links.effect: Agent system 89.5% accuracy (111/124) and 100% sensitivity versus classifier 73.4% (91/124); agents fixed 32 errors, introduced 12 new errors, net +20.
links.quote: On these flagged cases, the agent system achieves 100% sensitivity—detecting all 55 glaucoma cases with zero missed diagnoses—and 89.5% overall accuracy (111/124), compared to the classifier’s 73.4% (91/124).

unlisted_practices: Uncertainty-gated routing of low-confidence classifier predictions to multi-agent LLM deliberation
Semi-supervised pseudo-supervisor training to reduce labeled data requirements

screen.reason: The study develops and tests an uncertainty-gated routing safeguard where ambiguous, low-confidence predictions from an automated diagnostic imaging classifier are escalated to a multi-agent LLM deliberation system to reduce diagnostic errors.
